角色设计：
你是一个提示词翻译官，你要把提示词按照要求翻译成英文，要求是：除了对白内容，其余内容翻译成英文。同时根据图片角色补充角色描述词。除了说话内容，其余一律使用英文。不要有**Character Prompt (for AI Image Generation):**等标题，直接输出翻译内容。必须要自然语言，动作连贯。比如：某某角色说：你好。后面的“你好。”是中文，其余全部是英文。中文对白不要换行。（如果用户输入了图片，根据图片以及用户给的基础提示词，完善成新的提示词，让动作更加流畅）

比如用户输入：电影写实风格，0-5秒，镜头缓缓推进，女子正在整理头发。5-10秒，切换至女子全身照镜头，女子正在热血，做着拳击动作。10-15秒，切换至女子的脸部特写照，她看着观众说：等下有你好看的，渣滓！(声线：清晰且尖锐，语速：快速)

输出结果：Cinematic and realistic style, dynamic and fierce mood. 0-5秒, woman is gently adjusting and styling her hair, showing a calm preparation. 5-10秒, switches to a full shot, she becomes passionate and energetic, performing a series of intense boxing combinations with sharp punches. 10-15秒, switches to a tight facial close-up shot, she stares directly into the camera, looking at the audience with an aggressive glare. 0-5秒, slow dolly in, emphasis composition. 5-10秒, full shot with dynamic tracking movement. 10-15秒, tight close-up, static camera. Realistic indoor gym lighting, strong key light, high contrast shadows, desaturated cool tones. 10-15秒，The woman with blue hair said:等下有你好看的，渣滓！Voice: clear and sharp, Pace: fast. Ambient gym sounds, wind resistance from fast punches, sudden dramatic BGM crescendo, precise lip-sync. film grain, cinematic bokeh，无字幕。
worst quality, blurry, jittery, distorted, inconsistent appearance，

Cinematic and realistic style, dynamic and fierce mood. 0-5 seconds, slow dolly in on a Chinese Southern mountain off-road track: two Chinese motocross riders launch into the air from a dirt jump. The lead rider, Haojue #7 (red bike), is mid-flight with his body leaning forward; the chaser, CFMOTO #21 (blue bike), follows closely behind, wheels kicking up mud. Background features lush green karst peaks, terraced fields, and spectators waving red Chinese flags on a hillside.
5-10 seconds, full shot tracking movement: after landing, rider #7 enters a sharp hairpin turn at extreme lean angle; rider #21 overtakes him on the inside line. Both bikes roar with engine power, dust swirling in golden sunlight. Rider #7 turns his head back and shouts aggressively in Mandarin: "想超我？没门！" Voice: powerful and intense, pace: rapid. Camera follows motion smoothly, shallow depth of field blurs background mountains slightly to emphasize speed.
10-15 seconds, tight close-up on rider #21’s face as he crosses the finish line first—helmet visor reflecting sun, eyes focused with determination. He points skyward triumphantly while rider #7 slams his fist against his tank in frustration, yelling: "我赢了!" Voice: loud and defiant. Slow-motion captures crowd cheering wildly behind them, flags fluttering dramatically. Lighting is natural daylight with strong directional shadows from midday sun; composition uses leading lines of the dirt track guiding viewer’s eye toward finish line. Background foliage rendered as green light streaks due to motion blur.
Cinematic and realistic style, dynamic and fierce mood. 0-5 seconds: Slow dolly in on a dirt bike race track nestled in the lush green mountains of Southern China. Two Chinese riders are locked in an intense battle for position. The rider on the left, wearing red racing gear with a red Haojue motorcycle, is aggressively leaning into a turn, kicking up a spray of brown mud. The rider on the right, clad in blue gear riding a teal Chunfeng bike (number 21), is pushing hard to overtake.
5-10 seconds: Switches to a full shot with dynamic tracking movement. Both bikes are now airborne, launching off a massive dirt mound. Mud and debris explode into the air around them against a backdrop of verdant terraced fields and distant karst peaks. Spectators in the background wave Chinese flags enthusiastically from behind safety barriers.
10-15 seconds: Switches to a tight close-up on the red rider's face as he lands hard, looking back with an aggressive glare at his rival. He shouts: "想超我？没门！" (Voice: clear and sharp, Pace: fast). The camera follows him into a high-speed straightaway where both bikes blur past, creating golden trails of dust in the sunlight.
12-15 seconds: Final shot focuses on the finish line crossing. The blue rider crosses first with a half-body lead, pointing triumphantly to the sky while the red rider slams his fist against his tank in frustration, shouting "我赢了!" (I won!). Slow motion captures the intense determination under their helmets as the crowd erupts in cheers waving national flags.
Camera angles: Low angle tracking shots emphasizing speed and height during jumps; dynamic side-profile tracking for straightaways; extreme close-ups on facial expressions and helmet details. Lighting: Natural bright daylight with strong contrast shadows cast by bikes and riders, highlighting texture of mud and terrain. Composition: Uses leading lines from the dirt track curves to guide viewer’s eye through action sequences; shallow depth of field keeps focus sharp on foreground riders while softly blurring mountainous background for cinematic effect.
Cinematic and realistic style, dynamic and fierce mood. 0-5 seconds, slow dolly in on a dirt track in the southern mountains of China, two Chinese motocross riders are airborne mid-jump over a dusty hill; one rider in red on a Haojue motorcycle and another in blue on a CFMOTO bike, mud splashing dramatically behind them, with green karst peaks and spectators waving red flags on a distant ridge. 5-10 seconds, switches to full shot tracking the riders as they land hard into a sharp turn; the red rider leans aggressively while the blue rider overtakes inside, both bikes tilted at extreme angles, engines roaring through the valley, camera follows with dynamic motion blur and low-angle perspective for intensity. 7-11 seconds, straightaway acceleration phase, blue rider surges ahead, red rider pushes to catch up, speed exceeding 120 km/h, bamboo forests on either side of the mountain road streak into green light trails, golden dust swirls in sunlight forming a hazy atmospheric glow. 11-15 seconds, approaching finish line, blue rider crosses first by half a bike length, celebrates triumphantly pointing skyward with one finger; red rider slams fist against fuel tank shouting “I won!” while crowd waves national flags wildly on stands above, slow-motion capture freezes the determined expression under winner’s helmet. Camera angles shift from wide tracking shots to tight close-ups emphasizing emotion and speed. Lighting is natural daylight filtered through forest canopy creating high contrast shadows and warm highlights. Composition uses leading lines of dirt track converging toward horizon, rule of thirds placing riders off-center for dynamism. Shallow depth of field blurs background foliage into soft bokeh while keeping foreground action sharp. Ambient sounds include engine roars, tire screeches, crowd cheers, wind rushing past bikes, and sudden dramatic BGM crescendo at finish. Film grain texture enhances realism, no subtitles displayed.
Cinematic and realistic style, dynamic and fierce mood. 0-5 seconds: slow dolly in on a wide shot of the China Southern Mountain Cross-Country Track. Two Chinese motocross riders are airborne over a dirt mound; one rides a red Haojue motorcycle, the other a blue CFMOTO bike chasing closely behind. Mud splashes as they soar against a backdrop of green mountains and spectators waving red flags under bright natural sunlight.
5-10 seconds: switches to full shot with dynamic tracking movement. The red rider lands hard and dives into a sharp turn; the blue rider overtakes boldly on the inside line. Both bikes lean at extreme angles, engines roaring loudly through the valley. Composition uses leading lines from the track curve guiding eyes toward action. Shallow depth of field keeps focus on riders while background blurs slightly for motion emphasis.
10-15 seconds: tight close-up on red rider’s face as he shouts aggressively back at blue rider: "想超我？没门！" Voice: clear and powerful, Chinese accent. Camera follows his head turn sharply. Background shows blurred bamboo forest glowing green in sunlight; golden dust swirls around tires creating dramatic lighting effects from sun rays piercing through.
15-20 seconds: medium tracking shot down straightaway as blue rider accelerates suddenly ahead; red rider pushes hard to catch up. Both bikes exceed 120 km/h, surrounded by swirling dirt and shimmering light beams cutting through air. Symmetrical composition with riders centered frame flanked by vertical bamboo stalks forming natural guide lines.
20-25 seconds: extreme low-angle shot at finish line as blue rider crosses first with half-body lead, arm raised triumphantly toward sky; red rider slams fuel tank in frustration yelling "我赢了!" Voice: desperate but loud. Crowd cheers wildly waving Chinese flags filling background. Slow-motion captures intense expression under helmet visor — shallow depth of field isolates winner against cheering masses behind soft bokeh.
Lighting: strong directional sunlight from upper right casting long shadows, high contrast between bright sky and dusty track surface. Color palette dominated by earthy reds/browns accented with vivid blue/red bike colors and national flag crimson yellows.

分镜1（0-3秒）： 中国南方山区越野赛道，中国车手驾驶红色豪爵摩托车飞跃土坡，另一位中国车手驾驶蓝色春风摩托车紧追不舍，两车腾空而起，泥浆四溅，背景是青山绿水和红旗飘扬的观众看台。
分镜2（3-7秒）： 红车手落地后冲入急弯，蓝车手大胆内线超车，两辆国产摩托车并驾齐驱，车身倾斜角度极大，引擎轰鸣声震山谷，红车手回头大喊："想超我？没门！"（普通话，声线激昂有力）。
分镜3（7-11秒）： 直道加速段，蓝车手突然爆发速度领先，红车手全力追赶，两车时速突破120公里，山间道路两侧的竹林化作绿色流光，尘土在阳光下形成金色烟雾。
分镜4（11-15秒）： 终点线前，蓝车手以半个车身优势冲线，兴奋地单手指天庆祝，红车手不甘心地猛拍油箱，高呼："我赢了" 看台上观众挥舞国旗热烈欢呼，慢动作捕捉胜利者头盔下的坚毅面容。
